description: Build a chronologically-ordered context window for a session. Returns ordered items: fresh-tail raw rows + level-2 summary substitutions for older rows + budget-fit. Hippo-additive vs lossless-claw: eviction picks lowest-strength non-fresh-tail items first instead of oldest-first. Tenant-scoped; default-deny on private scopes.

budget.description: Token budget for the assembled context (default 4000; max 100000). Eviction kicks in over budget.

fresh_tail_count.description: Recent raw rows always kept verbatim (default 10). These are never evicted.

scope.description: Restrict to memories whose scope matches exactly. When omitted, default-deny applies to ANY <source>:private:* scope and unknown:legacy rows. Pass an explicit scope to assemble a private session with consent.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Returns clean empty result if no kind=raw rows match.

summarize_older.description: When true (default), older raws sharing a level-2 parent summary get substituted. Set false to keep every older raw as-is.

name: hippo_assemble
